name: answered-own-task-stays-open
why: A wake by the owner makes a task Intake filed the run's own task, and the owner put it back in Intake's hands. Its source is answered, so the run adds one task_comment and arms a task_wait for the owner: the task stays open and waits on them instead of going idle (swept back) or being closed (a real close went done in the same second as Intake's answering comment).
